task_description:
Create and process a new dispute for billing item BILL-0002, then finalize an existing dispute on the same item:

1) New dispute creation and staging:
- Create a new dispute for billing_item_id BILL-0002 with:
  - submitter_id: CUST-2711
  - dispute_reason: “Storm damage credit not applied”
- Validate that the dispute is correctly linked to billing item BILL-0002.
- Assign resolver_id to OP-INNA for this new dispute.
- Update its resolution_status to in_review using an authorized operator (OP-INNA).
- Add resolution_details: “Reviewing eligibility for storm credit; documents requested from customer.”
- Record the resolution_date timestamp for the status change.

2) Finalize existing dispute DSP-c3fb2128:
- Confirm allowed resolution_status values include accepted.
- Update DSP-c3fb2128’s resolution_status from in_review to accepted using authorized operator OP-JOHN.
- Set/replace resolution_details to: “Verified overcharge; $20 credit will be applied to the next billing cycle.”
- Assign/confirm resolver_id as OP-JOHN.
- Record the resolution_date timestamp for this resolution update.

Notes:
- Use only permitted resolution statuses; if a requested status is not allowed, do not proceed with that change.
- Ensure each state change records the responsible operator and timestamp.
- Do not modify any other disputes beyond the above.
